Subject: Intro — exploring AWS marketplace + co-sell for CloudMed

Hey Ben —

Thanks for the quick connect last week. As mentioned, CloudMed is evaluating ways to distribute our clinical summarization feature through the AWS Marketplace and explore AWS co-sell motion to get strategic coverage from the account team. High level: we need a marketplace listing, joint GTM play, and a co-sell plan that aligns with an upcoming pilot with St. Augustine Health (pilot kickoff targeted June).

Can you introduce the right Redwood folks and recommend next steps? Ideally we get a 30-min intro next week and then a more detailed mutual action plan (MAP) workshop.

A few helpful details on our side:
- Pilot scope: 10 clinics, near-real-time summarization, PHI in-scope with BAA
- Target contract size if pilot expands: $250k ARR
- Timeline: pilot signed by end of May, production early Q4

Thanks — looping Alice (Ops) who will handle scheduling.

—Sam

Sam, Ben — thanks for the intro. A few technical points to flag for the MAP workshop so expectations are aligned:

1) Marketplace listing types — we support AMI, SaaS, and private offers. For near-real-time summarization with PHI, SaaS on a VPC peering model or private offer is most common.
2) Security/compliance — we'll need your SOC2 type II report or an equivalent security questionnaire. Also confirm if you require a BAA (you noted PHI scope).
3) Integration surface — typical architectures: (a) CloudMed hosts inference and we integrate via secure API; (b) Customer deploys a private instance with Redwood private deployment. We should map data residency and latency requirements.
4) Minimum marketplace readiness items: billing account, product description, screenshots, SSO/OAuth info (if applicable), and a contact for procurement.

Can you share sample requests (anonymized) and your security questionnaire? I attached our security checklist to show the common asks.

Attachments: security-questions.xlsx

I can lead the MAP tech section on the workshop. For times — Wed 4/7 15:00 PST works for me.

—Laura

Hi team — quick procurement note from Redwood ops: 

- Typical procurement runway for marketplace private offers + pilot contract: 3–6 weeks once procurement contacts are aligned.
- For pilots that could expand to ~$250k ARR, we can provisionally approve a pilot discount and a Marketplace promotional credit to make the pilot easier to sign. Final discount requires deal desk sign-off.
- DocuSign flow: we'll prepare a pilot SOW + private offer terms. If CloudMed can provide the legal contact for pilot (name, email, and billing entity), we can draft and push within 48–72 hours after the MAP is agreed.

I attached a short term sheet with example pilot pricing and common T&Cs.
